_meta.description: Embr plans your path to debt freedom on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch: two payoff plans side by side, instant recalculation, widgets, Siri and Shortcuts. Zero data collection, iCloud sync, one purchase.
_title: Embr - Plan Your Path to Debt Freedom

blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
does-embr-collect-my.e7c901: Does Embr collect my financial data?
embr-draws-your-payoff.cb3724: Embr draws your payoff with minimum payments and with extra payments. Drag a debt to the top to tackle it first, and every date recalculates instantly.
embr-on-apple-watch.c7c231: Embr on Apple Watch showing 48 percent paid
embr-s-payoff-math.a1ed14: Embr's payoff math was checked by an accountant, and it factors in each debt's interest rate and any extra payments. Treat the dates as a plan to aim for, since real balances change as you pay.
enter-a-new-balance.f8e7e3: Enter a new balance and your totals and payoff date follow. Widgets, Siri and Shortcuts keep the next payment in sight.
enter-your-debts-and.d8a582: Enter your debts and see the day you'll be free of them, and how much sooner extra payments get you there.
every-payment-you-make.35e2ab: Every payment you make, you can watch it count.
how-accurate-are-the.e13f38: How accurate are the payoff plans?
is-embr-available-in.4e04e1: Is Embr available in the European Union?
no-embr-collects-zero.b453dc: No! Embr collects zero data. Everything runs on your device with complete privacy. No tracking, no servers, no sharing your financial information with anyone. Your debt details stay completely private.
no-embr-is-a.d397ef: No! Embr is a one-time purchase that works across all your Apple devices—iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Buy once and use forever with no recurring subscription fees.
no-tracking-no-servers.456448: No tracking, no servers, and no sharing your financial information with anyone.
plan-your-path-to.deca93: Plan Your Path to Debt Freedom
progress-rings-for-your.fe99ee: Progress rings for your total and every debt, and payments logged with a turn of the Digital Crown.
the-embr-dashboard-comparing.5d6934: The Embr dashboard, comparing paying extra with paying minimums
updating-a-card-s.1bfabe: Updating a card's balance from the dashboard
yes-embr-is-on.d6f25e: Yes. Embr is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
your-debt-plans-and.bc13ba: Your debt plans and progress sync seamlessly across all your Apple devices via iCloud. Monitor your debt payoff journey from your iPhone, check progress on your iPad, or plan at your Mac—always in sync.
